migrations.name: 041_decision_evidence
migrations.note: additive only: new tables and indexes; no existing table is altered or rebuilt; foreign keys reference jobs, artifacts and principals
migrations.rollback: SQLite: restore the pre-migration backup made by the established backup process (metacoin_service backup --include-keys) or, if no new rows were written, DROP the seven objects and delete the schema_migrations row 041_decision_evidence; a service at the previous revision ignores the new tables and runs unchanged
migrations.recovery: the migration runs inside migrate() in its own transaction; a failure rolls the whole step back and leaves schema 040 intact; rerunning migrate is idempotent

live_service: NOT upgraded by this order: the owner's live service (tmux metacoin-service, 127.0.0.1:8402) stays at 3e34126 / schema 040; development and verification used disposable instances and temporary state directories only
evaluation_registry: fault suites are stored as evaluation suites (item type fault_case, split dev|held-out) in the existing tables; no schema change
